title: Step-by-step assembly and testing of a low-cost bioprinting solution for research and educational purposes
author: Honiball, Pepper, et al.

steps.title: Assemble Prusa i3 printer
steps.instruction: Assemble the RepRap Prusa i3 kit (maximum build volume 200 × 200 × 200 mm, dual 8 mm T8 lead screws for Z‑axis) according to the supplier’s instructions (DIYElectronics, South Africa) or the RepRap.org Prusa i3 wiki (accessed March 2020).

steps.title: Print extruder components
steps.instruction: Download the universal paste extruder STL files from Thingiverse (user RichRap, #20733) and the modified extruder body (#1125286); print all parts on a Wanhao Duplicator i3 using 1.75 mm Verbatim PLA filament. Use an aluminum GT2 pulley with grub screws instead of the printed GT2 pulley.

steps.title: Mount NEMA 17 stepper motor
steps.instruction: Attach a NEMA 17 stepper motor to the printed extruder body with four M3 × 10 mm screws.

steps.title: Install motor drive gear
steps.instruction: Insert an M3 nut into the nut holder of the printed small (motor drive) gear, then secure the gear to the NEMA 17 motor with an M3 × 10 mm screw passing through the nut.

steps.title: Attach large gear to extruder body
steps.instruction: Slide an M4 × 75 mm screw through the printed large gear, then add eight M4 washers and a 624ZZ bearing; pass the screw (with washers and bearing) through the GT2 pulley (positioned between two M4 washers) in the middle of the extruder body, continue the screw through the body, add a second 624ZZ bearing, seven more M4 washers, and finish with an M4 nut‑lock.

steps.title: Install bearing in syringe cap
steps.instruction: Insert a 624ZZ bearing into the printed syringe cap by threading an M3 × 20 mm screw through the bearing and cap, then secure with an M3 nut.

steps.title: Thread GT2 timing belt
steps.instruction: Feed a GT2 toothed rubber timing belt through the syringe‑cap bearing, pass it through the aluminum GT2 pulley, and route it into the space between the NEMA 17 motor and the printed extruder body.

steps.title: Secure double gear
steps.instruction: Slide an M4 × 60 mm screw through the printed double gear, then add five M4 washers and a 624ZZ bearing; with the GT2 belt tightened, continue the screw with ten additional M4 washers and finish with an M4 nut‑lock.

steps.title: Mount idler bearing
steps.instruction: Attach a 608ZZ bearing to the printed idler by inserting an M8 × 20 mm smooth rod through the bearing and into the idler.

steps.title: Attach idler to extruder body
steps.instruction: Secure the idler base to the extruder body with an M4 × 35 mm screw; insert two M3 nuts into the top‑side slots of the extruder body, then fix the top of the idler with an M3 × 45 mm screw and a 15 mm spring.

steps.title: Mount extruder on printer
steps.instruction: Mount the assembled universal paste extruder onto the Prusa i3 X‑carriage by fastening the printed extruder body to the carriage with two M3 × 40 mm screws.

steps.title: Connect electronics and power
steps.instruction: Connect the NEMA 17 stepper‑motor cables to the E0 plug on the RAMPS 1.4 board, connect the RAMPS 1.4 board to an Arduino MEGA 2560, and power the system with an external 220 V supply.
